_note: W6 投影片引用的數字與出處。dead_codes 是 make_figs_w06.py 用純 numpy 算出來的（Demo 3 的 demo.py 要用同一個 seed 重現並 selftest 對這份）；paper_settings 是投影片引用的原文設定值（2026-10-17 對 arXiv PDF）。Demo 1、2 的量測數字不在這裡，建好之後進 w06-metrics.json。

dead_codes._how:
2-D 玩具：四團高斯落在 [3, 6]² 裡（中心 (3.6,3.6) (5.4,3.6) (3.6,5.4) (5.4,5.4)，std 0.3），codebook V = 16。
    五種設定，每一種回報「有被選到的 code 數」與量化 MSE（最後 20 步的平均）：
      (1) random-init + gradient   codebook 以 N(0, I) 初始化在資料之外，只用 codebook loss 的梯度更新（straight-through 的世界裡
                                   codebook 只有被選到的 code 收到梯度；這裡沒有 encoder，資料固定，所以只剩 codebook 這一組參數）
      (2) random-init + EMA        同樣的初始化，改成 EMA 更新（c_v、m_v）——一樣只更新被選到的 code
      (3) k-means-init + EMA       codebook 以第一個 batch 的 k-means 中心初始化（SoundStream 的做法），再 EMA
      (4) random-init + EMA + dead-code reset   幾步沒被選到的 code 換成當前 batch 的一個點（Jukebox／SoundStream）
      (5) FSQ Λ = (4, 4)           沒有 codebook：z 經固定仿射（把 [3, 6]² 對到約 [−2, 2]²）→ tanh → 格點；FSQ 原文對偶數 Λ 用半格偏移
    這裡的 collapse 不是調出來的：它是「初始化在資料支撐之外」的直接後果——把 init 移進資料裡（設定 3）就不死。

vqvae.ema_where: Appendix A.1, eqs. 6–8; VQ-VAE-2 §2.1 uses EMA throughout

soundstream.codebook_init: k-means on the first training batch (§III-C)
soundstream.dead_code: a codeword not assigned any input frame for several batches is replaced by an input frame randomly sampled within the current batch (§III-C)
soundstream.abstract: at 3 kbps outperforms Opus at 12 kbps and approaches EVS at 9.6 kbps

encodec.derivation: 75 steps/s × log2(1024) = 10 bit = 750 bps per codebook; §3.2 only says the number of codebooks is a multiple of 4 and lists the five bandwidths — the mapping is this course's arithmetic
encodec.discriminator: multi-scale STFT (MS-STFT), hinge loss, relative feature matching, loss balancer (§3.4)
encodec.comparison: EnCodec at 3 kbps reaches better performance on average than Lyra-v2 using 6 kbps and Opus at 12 kbps (§4.5)
encodec.streamable: two setups: low-latency streamable (all padding before the first step) and non-streamable (1 s chunks, 10 ms overlap)

mimi.transformer: one before and one after quantisation, in the bottleneck
mimi.split_rvq: a plain VQ (semantic, distilled) in parallel with a 7-level RVQ; outputs summed (§3.3.2)
mimi.distillation: WavLM-large, 1024-d at 50 Hz, non-causal average pooling stride 4 kernel 8 to 12.5 Hz, linear projection, cosine distance; layer not stated
mimi.adversarial_only: experiment keeps only feature loss and discriminator loss; 'remarkable boost'; Table 4 MUSHRA 81.0 vs 58.8; whether the released model is this variant is not stated in prose
mimi.quantization_rate_during_training: quantisation applied 50% of the time per sequence (§3.3.1)

speechtokenizer.teacher: HuBERT layer 9 or the average of all layers (§3.2); Tables 6–7 captions use the all-layer average
speechtokenizer.distillation: continuous: maximise dimension-wise cosine similarity across all time steps; pseudo-label: cross-entropy on HuBERT units; first quantizer only
speechtokenizer.appendix_E: the remaining seven quantizers produce acoustic tokens

fsq.formula: round(floor(L/2) · tanh z) per dimension; even L uses a half-level offset (paper's code)

opus._source: RFC 6716 §2 — a standard, not a paper

budget._how: token rate = f_r · N_q; context(30 min) = f_r · N_q · 1800; steps/s: flatten = f_r · N_q, RQ-Transformer = f_r; latency floor = 1/f_r
budget.text_estimate: ≈2.5 characters/s, 1–2 BPE tokens per character → 30 min ≈ 5–10 k tokens; the measured count comes from Demo 2 (Gemma 4 tokenizer) and goes to w06-metrics.json
